Name: Traveling Cart sells All CC items
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
[u]Traveling Cart sells all items for Community Center bundles; both standard and remixed.[/u] 
Have you thought about taking the JoJa route because it is easier to make money than grow crops, fish, etc.; but you still want to complete the Community Center? With this mod, you can buy what you need at the Traveling cart. (Including gold quality crops.)

You can choose which group of items you want to include. 4 groups: fish, gems, crops and misc. 
The following items are used in standard and/or remixed bundles. All other items that are used are already sold at the Traveling Cart. Items will show up randomly. Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Blossom5280?gameId=1303]Blossom5280[/url] and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/EmmaNolan?gameId=1303]EmmaNolan[/url] for figuring this out for me.

[b]Insulation[/b]
1. Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.﻿﻿
2. Download and Extract Content Patcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Download and Extract Generic Mod Config Menu mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿ (optional but
recommended)
4. Download and Extract [b]Traveling Cart sells all CC items[/b] into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿﻿﻿
5. Launch Stardew Valley. To enable the settings you want, click the cog wheel on the bottom left of the
Stardew Valley title screen.
